question: Does a charge-coordinate OCV representation preserve the joint cost/gradient/GN better per byte than a uniform parameter basis?
scope: Stationary known-tanh-OCV representation diagnostic. No optimizer, plant truth, aging, thermal learning or canonical trajectory.

arms.uniform_baseline: Same dynamic degree used also for total-degree z0/chi OCV as predecessor. Degrees2/3/4 compared to saved predecessor results; degree1 new low-memory control.

charge_domain.rule: Use the same fixed interval for every candidate: [(public_z_upper-1)/chi_max,public_z_lower/chi_max], chi_max=exp(-public_logQ_lower). Every public z0/Q candidate remains physically legal throughout this charge interval.
charge_domain.no_future_fit: Interval comes from public support, never data extrema, truth or observed errors.
charge_domain.failure: Source prefix outside interval unavailable; no regridding, extrapolation, resetting or dropping history.
charge_domain.OCV: At query interpolate the original U(z0-chi*C) at degree+1 fixed charge Chebyshev nodes. Keep original curve and all alpha/rate uncertainty.

representation.dynamic_row: Fixed inherited response basis plus -observed_voltage as a constant feature; amplitudes remain original query functions, including H*h0.
blocks: G=sum dynamic_row outer dynamic_row, full packed triangle
representation.reconstruction: H_ij=(M_(i+j)+M_abs(i-j))/2; full feature Gram=[[G,B],[B^T,H]]. This reconstructs cost,gradient and GN of the represented residual exactly in real arithmetic.
representation.cross_terms: All dynamic-dynamic and dynamic-OCV mixed terms retained; no observation split into independent evidence.
representation.controls: Full QR over the same residual rows, direct row evaluation, partitioned/global-row summation; positive-semidefinite matrix controls on frozen cases.
representation.not_selected: Collapsing parameter-basis products can preserve cost but lose the residual-Jacobian Gram needed by unchanged rolling solver; do not count that cost-only saving as query-complete storage.
representation.exact_OCV_control: Desktop raw-history control: exact OCV at each actual charge combined with the same approximated dynamic response. Separates remaining rate-basis error from OCV representation error; not a bounded candidate.

memory.extra_candidate_query_scratch_B: 8*(3*(M+K)+3*K+10*(d+1)+16); additive conservative phase allocation, no unproved aliasing
memory.limitations: Includes planned solver workspace,raw queue,calibration,auxiliary,project stack,runtime/IRQ reservations from old ledger. New C solver integration,stack,latency and target execution unmeasured. Diagnostic Python full matrices excluded from deployment proposal; not claimed firmware-ready. Static basis tables may reside in program ROM, never historical evidence.

checks.criterion_scope: Inherited descriptive finite-stencil contrast gate, not physical battery accuracy or replacement for canonical545 query gate.
checks.numerical_failures: Collect all finite mismatches without changing tolerances; hard source/domain/ownership violations stop. Preserve first result and any correction separately.
checks.PSD: Record smallest Gram eigenvalue relative to matrix norm; allowance128*eps*F*norm. No clipping/ridge.
checks.cancellation_control: At4096/dynamic_degree2/OCV_degree8/full_public, replace the observed constant row coefficient so represented residual at public mean cancels. Compare direct/QR/moment arithmetic; no new physical model or inference.

outputs: frozen source/input identities and source snapshots
cost/gradient/endpoint comparisons and GN numerical controls
full storage ledger for both layouts
decision with failure severity and no scope promotion
